messages:
Mia: Quick sync — coming from Q3 customer calls: we need clearer launch rubric for routing/region guarantees. customers asking for predictable latency and regional residency at the same time.
Sanjay: Agreed. Our current proposal feels fuzzy. Can we list concrete SLOs + what triggers Dedicated/Private offering?
Elaine: Sketch: three acceptance gates — (1) latency tail at 95th <= X ms for pinned region, (2) soft-degradation path (fallback models) with <2x cost delta, (3) compliance check for data residency. If any fail, require Private/Dedicated.
Amelia: Ops concern — fallbacks cause cache churn. Need a runbook for KV cache warm-up and cross-region circuit breakers.
Raj: From sales: customers expect pricing bands tied to guarantees. If we require Dedicated for certain guarantees, we need clearly written contract language.
Mia: Proposed experiment: pilot with 2 customers in EU/NA, run policy variants for 6 weeks and measure latency, cost per token, and cold-start penalty.
Sanjay: For the pilot we need a config template. Draft:
```
policy:
  mode: latency-first
  region_affinity: strong
  fallback: model-small-1
  cache_policy: prefix_cache
```
Elaine: Add metric hooks: per-route P95, P99, request fanout, cache-miss-rate. We'll need trace ids in responses to map failures.
Amelia: Also require circuit breaker thresholds: 5% errors over 1m -> route to fallback; 3 consecutive 5s spikes -> scale or degrade.
Raj: What's the ETA to produce a go/no-go checklist for sales? Customers want it in their RFP addendum.
Mia: I'll draft a one-page rubric this week. Owners: Mia (product), Elaine (architecture), Amelia (ops). Send to Raj for legal/contract phrasing.
Sanjay: Priority ranking for work: 1) pilot infra (routing + metrics), 2) cache warm-up work, 3) SLA/contract text, 4) Console UX for guardrails.
Amelia: Heads-up: infra work needs 2-week runway for safe canary. Recommend feature flag + rollout plan.
Elaine: For long-term architecture, we should codify policy precedence: 1) customer-level explicit pin, 2) latency SLO, 3) cost override. Will iterate on DSL semantics.
Mia: Action items:  - Mia: one-pager rubric + pilot ask by Fri  - Elaine: draft policy DSL snippet and metric list by Tues  - Sanjay: infra plan + estimate for canary by Tues  - Amelia: runbook skeleton + circuit breaker thresholds by Wed  - Raj: list top-3 customers to invite to pilot
ops-bot: created task board https://ourboard.example.com/board/ROUTING-5198765432
Raj: I'll pull legal and customer success in after your one-pager, Mia. Also can offer two customers for pilot.
Mia: Thanks all — followups in dedicated thread when drafts land. :thumbsup:
